label: Longitudinal panel: United Kingdom 1861–1930, EU/UNECE 2018–2026, Great Britain 2024–2026
second_pass: First-pass coding; no second pass recorded.
caveats: The Hub sheet records no coding date per panel; snapshot_date is the export date. Modern rows (2018–2026) are coded against the sources listed in each row.
Historical scores are based on the presence or absence of technology-specific integration in each layer, not on the density of regulation.
Longitudinal EU/UNECE and Great Britain rows overlap with the 2026 cross-section and may differ by one stage where the coding rule was applied more strictly in the cross-section.
